#labels stlinux
Wydevices are cross-compiled with STLinux 2.3.

The better way is to compile all mods with the same cross-compiler.

Here my howto for install a cross-compiler platorm.


*This howto use :*
	* VMware Player v3 or later (you can launch this program on any operating system).
	* Fedora 11 32bits.
	* STLinux 2.3.

*Note :*
	The root password for this Fedora11 is "STL/nux".

*Necessary packages :*
	* Download and install the free VMware Player v3 from [http://www.vmware.com/products/player/] (~70 Mo)
	* Download and uncompact [ftp://ftp.stlinux.com/pub/vmware/40G-fedora11.zip] (~650 Mo)
	* Download STLinux 2.3 from [ftp://ftp.stlinux.com/pub/stlinux/2.3/iso/STLinux-2.3-sh4-03-11-07.iso] (~650 Mo)

	* Launch you Fedora 11 virtual machine and terminate installation.
	* Insert STLinux-2.3-sh4-03-11-07.iso into VMware.
	* Run this command :
{{{
$ mkdir $HOME/stlinux_install
$ cd $HOME/stlinux_install
$ cp -R /media/STLinux-2.3-sh4/ $HOME/stlinux_install/
$ wget http://www.stlinux.com/drupal/sites/default/files/stlinux23-host-STLinux_deps-0.1-4.i386.rpm
$ su - (enter root password)
# rpm -ivh stlinux23-host-STLinux_deps-0.1-4.i386.rpm
# cd /home/user/stlinux_install/
# ./install all-sh4-glibc
}}}
	* At this step, the install script show many error from python.
	* For fix this errors, we will replace "with" by "mdtype" in python scripts :
{{{
# sed -i "s/with=/mdtype=/" /opt/STM/STLinux-2.3/host/usr/lib/python2.3/site-packages/yum/__init__.py
# sed -i "s/with=/mdtype=/" /opt/STM/STLinux-2.3/host/usr/lib/python2.3/site-packages/yum/repos.py
# sed -i "s/with=/mdtype=/" /opt/STM/STLinux-2.3/host/usr/share/yum-cli/cli.py
# sed -i "s/with=/mdtype=/" /opt/STM/STLinux-2.3/host/usr/lib/yum-plugins/changelog.py
}}}
	* Re-run the install script, get the line of error and replace manually with gedit "with" by "mdtype".
{{{
# ./install all-sh4-glibc
# gedit /opt/STM/STLinux-2.3/host/usr/lib/python2.3/site-packages/yum/repos.py
}}}
	* Now, you can launch installation of STLinux 2.3 without errors.
{{{
# ./install all-sh4-glibc
}}}
	* After installation, update your STLinux 2.3 to the last packages revision and install additionnal packages.
{{{
# /opt/STM/STLinux-2.3/host/bin/stmyum update
# /opt/STM/STLinux-2.3/host/bin/stmyum clean all
# /opt/STM/STLinux-2.3/host/bin/stmyum install stlinux23-sh4-curl stlinux23-sh4-curl-dev stlinux23-sh4-libopenssl stlinux23-sh4-libopenssl-dev stlinux23-sh4-psmisc
}}}

Yes, you are now ready for cross-compilation.

In the next step, we are going to compile programs and library.

The Fedora 11 launch automaticly autoupdates, accept only security fixes.
